title: Auditing Post-Training Unlearning in Diffusion Language Models using Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.27652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine unlearning is an approach to privacy protection: it aims to remove the influence of designated data while preserving the model's behavior on information that should be retained. While a growing body of work investigates this objective in autoregressive large language models, machine unlearning remains underexplored in diffusion language models (DLMs). DLMs generate text through iterative denoising, exposing partially masked states whose internal representations change throughout the generation process. This raises a DLM-specific question: can selective forgetting improve by identifying forget-data-associated features and adapting their suppression across denoising stages? We conduct a controlled investigation of this question in LLaDA-8B-Instruct. To evaluate the unlearning of knowledge plausibly encoded during pre-training, we use WMDP as our forget-domain benchmark. translated_title: 使用稀疏自编码器审计扩散语言模型的训练后遗忘
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘是一种隐私保护方法：其目标是在保留模型对应保留信息的正常行为的同时，移除指定数据的影响。尽管越来越多的研究在自回归大语言模型中探讨这一目标，但机器遗忘在扩散语言模型（DLM）中仍未得到充分研究。DLM通过迭代去噪生成文本，会暴露出部分掩码的中间状态，其内部表示在整个生成过程中不断变化。这引出了一个DLM特有的问题：能否通过识别与待遗忘数据相关的特征，并在不同去噪阶段调整对它们的抑制方式，从而改进选择性遗忘？我们在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上对这一问题进行了受控研究。为了评估预训练期间可能已编码知识的遗忘效果，我们使用WMDP作为遗忘领域基准。使用top-k稀疏自编码器和去噪状态重放，我们……
tldr: 该论文利用稀疏自编码器与去噪状态重放，首次对扩散语言模型（LLaDA-8B-Instruct）的训练后遗忘进行机制审计，探索通过识别与遗忘数据相关的特征并在各去噪阶段动态调整其抑制来改进选择性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper uses sparse autoencoders and denoising-state replay to audit post-training unlearning in diffusion language models (LLaDA-8B-Instruct), exploring whether identifying forget-data-associated features and adapting their suppression across denoising stages can improve selective forgetting.
